message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Anonymize manuscript for blind review: replace author name/affiliation with "Anonymous", comment out the institution-identifying Acknowledgments, and blind the self-citation by renaming the cite key and matching bib key our2023 -> anon2023.

hunks.oldText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary self-citation \cite{our2023}.
hunks.newText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary self-citation \cite{anon2023}.
